title: Choose Tenantry's opal world
question: The Pengopal brand is fixed: navy ink, the opal mosaic, opal-framed buttons and the T of tiles with an opal centre. Pick the world those wear across the welcome page, the apps, Admin and sign-in. Keep the roll, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Site plan
options.lineage: architects' drawing sheets and building plans
options.thesis: Tenantry drawn as a building plan: every customer is a unit, walls are the isolation.
materials: navy drawing sheet with a fine grid
white hairline walls and dimension lines
options.viewport: A full drawing sheet: acme and globex as opal units in the shared realm, initech in its own building, the guard and Postgres as dimension lines; the title block on the right holds the headline, the slug field and Create a workspace.
options.risk: A blueprint can read as cold engineering; the opal units and plain words have to carry the warmth.

raised.raise: Full traceability: any unit opens to its realm, its guard check and its row-level policy, the way a woven motif traces back to its punch row.
Type does the hierarchy alone: one face, a few sizes, no icons or illustrations competing with the plan.
Counts are physical events: a new workspace or member visibly changes the plan instead of a number ticking quietly.

options.label: Leaded glass
options.thesis: One window, a pane for every customer, held apart by lead: the opal mosaic becomes the glass.
materials: a clear pane for the words
options.viewport: The page is one tall arched window; acme, globex and initech glow as opal panes, unlit panes wait, and the large clear pane in the middle holds the headline and the slug field with Create a workspace.
options.risk: The most literal reading of the opal brand; it can turn decorative in Admin unless the lead lines become the real grid.

options.label: Workspace album
options.thesis: Workspaces are numbered slots: filled ones sit proud in opal, the next empty slot is where you sign up.
options.viewport: A light album spread: slots 01 to 03 hold acme, globex and initech as opal stickers; slot 04 is open and holds the slug field and Create a workspace.
options.case: Fuses cleanly with Home's setup checklist and the demo workspaces, and empty slots explain onboarding; loses on audience identification, since IT admins don't see themselves in a sticker album.
options.risk: Playful enough to feel unserious for security software if the stickers get cute.

options.label: Jacquard brocade
options.thesis: Binary thread choices weaving one motif.
options.viewport: A woven motif over its punch rows.
options.case: Fuses poorly: weaving says little about workspaces or sign-in to either audience.
options.kept: Traceability from the whole down to the single decision.

options.label: Festival lineup
options.case: Ranking customers by size contradicts equal isolation; weak for both audiences.
options.kept: Type carries the hierarchy with nothing else competing.

options.label: Nixie counter
options.thesis: Every count arrives as glowing plasma.
options.case: Tenantry isn't a metrics product, and orange plasma fights the opal brand.
options.kept: A changing count is a visible physical event.

options.label: Ebru marbling
options.thesis: Colours that displace but never mix.
options.viewport: A pigment bath you comb through.
options.case: Beautiful metaphor for colours that never mix, but no one can operate Admin inside a liquid.
options.kept: Neighbours that touch but never mix.

options.label: Versailles gardens
options.thesis: Axial vistas and hidden garden rooms.
options.case: Hedge green and gilt clash with navy and opal, and the grandeur misreads the product.
options.kept: Private rooms reached from one shared axis.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The developer-SaaS landing and dashboard everyone ships, in navy and opal, executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and two buttons on the left, an app screenshot on the right, a row of technology names below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every auth and identity product by design.
